subject: Legends when multiple attributes (colour, linestyle, fill) mapped to a single categorical variable and breaks/labels are needed

messages.author: 519455d3bf64680d
messages.subject: Legends when multiple attributes (colour, linestyle, fill) mapped to a single categorical variable and breaks/labels are needed
parts:
This code:

ggplot(data=diamonds)+geom_smooth(aes(x=table, y=price, colour=color,
fil=color, linetype=color))

produces a nice single legend. All I am trying to do is to change the
title and map the breaks to new labels.

So, I tried:

ggplot(data=diamonds)+geom_smooth(aes(x=table, y=price, colour=color,
fil=color, linetype=color))+scale_linetype(name="Test", breaks=c("D",
"E", "F", "G", "H", "I", "J"), labels=c("Dee", "Eee", "FFF", "Gee",
"ehH", "eye", "Jay"))

which breaks the legend into two elements... a linestyle which has all
my nice remaping of breaks and labels, and a colour component which
ignores those new labels.

I've mangled the syntax further to get three label entries, which is
definitively NOT what I want.
Any suggestions on syntax? And I'd welcome if someone could you walk
through the logic as the logic escapes me.

messages.subject: Re: Legends when multiple attributes (colour, linestyle, fill) mapped to a single categorical variable and breaks/labels are needed
parts:
Hi:

You have three aesthetics mapped to color, so you need to coordinate three scales to blend them into one:

ggplot(data=diamonds) +
   geom_smooth(aes(x=table, y=price, colour=color, fill=color, linetype=color)) +

I've been burned by this, too :)

HTH,
Dennis
